title: Contextual Cookbook Playlists for Console Onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a lightweight, contextual "cookbook" of guided templates (playlists) surfaced in empty states and onboarding flows across the Redwood Console. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for engineers integrating inference routes while educating them about cost controls and rollout patterns (canary, A/B, gradual traffic). Deliverables: Figma prototype, interactive Storybook components, acceptance criteria for PM/Eng handoff, and moderated usability test results.
background: New users and teams onboarding to Redwood often hit an empty routes/dashboards surface with little context. Current empty-state cards are informational but do not guide through production concepts like batching, KV cache hints, cost trade-offs, or rollout templates. We want short, actionable mini-playlists that combine a template (e.g., cost-conscious small-scale canary), a 2-step runbook, and a preview of estimated token cost impact.
design_goals: Reduce time-to-first-deploy from onboarding by 40% for sample workloads
Surface cost implications inline with templates (estimated tokens and relative cost tier)
Be non-intrusive: show progressive dismissal and re-surface in Help panel
Support copyable templates and one-click scaffold to a sandbox project
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates 3 playlist types: Quick Canary, Cost-Saver, Full Rollout
Each playlist card includes an estimated cost delta and runtime trade-offs
Prototype includes empty-state placement, dashboard card, and route creation flow
Design tokens and Storybook components available for Eng handoff
Usability test (n>=6) shows users can identify next step and start a sandbox route within 3 minutes

decisions: Defer per-customer personalized templates to Q3; initial launch will use templated playlists with editable parameters
Use a three-tier cost band (Low/Medium/High) and an expandable exact-estimate section for advanced users
Implement a server-rendered static empty-state for Private deployments to avoid telemetry dependency
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overloading the empty state with too much info -> Mitigation: progressive disclosure and a 2-step default card
Risk: Mismatch between estimated cost and real billing -> Mitigation: show conservative ranges and link to Optimize's calculator
Risk: Engineering bandwidth for Storybook components -> Mitigation: provide design tokens and a small interactive shim for 1.0
usability_notes: Early hallway tests (n=4) indicated users want a 'Try in sandbox' button and clear indication of what will change in their project
Participants confused by 'KV cache hint' wording — we will rename to 'Warm cache tip' and include a tooltip
